purpose: Map the eight approved Outdoor V6 chapter-level infographics to the matching curriculum chapters without treating them as replacements for the eleven more specific THC-OUT production briefs.

items.title: Site Selection & Seasonal Sun
items.alt: THC outdoor cultivation infographic explaining site selection, seasonal sun exposure, shade, drainage, airflow, access and local site constraints.
items.caption: Use the site itself as evidence: seasonal sun, drainage, airflow, access and nearby constraints all shape outdoor performance.

items.title: Hardening Off & Transplant Establishment
items.alt: THC outdoor cultivation infographic explaining gradual hardening off, transplant handling and early outdoor establishment monitoring.
items.caption: Transition plants gradually and judge establishment from plant response rather than a rigid calendar.

items.title: Outdoor Water, Irrigation & Root-Zone Balance
items.alt: THC outdoor cultivation infographic explaining irrigation coverage, drainage, root-zone moisture balance and observation-based watering decisions.
items.caption: Outdoor irrigation is a root-zone management problem: coverage, drainage, weather and plant demand must be interpreted together.

items.title: Wind, Support & Canopy Architecture
items.alt: THC outdoor cultivation infographic explaining wind exposure, branch leverage, support systems and canopy architecture.
items.caption: Support should distribute wind and branch loads while preserving healthy stem movement and canopy airflow.

items.title: Rain, Humidity & Flower Disease Risk
items.alt: THC outdoor cultivation infographic explaining rain, humidity, dense flowers, drying conditions and disease-risk interactions.
items.caption: Flower disease risk rises from interacting moisture, temperature, structure and drying conditions—not from one weather reading alone.

items.title: Pests, Scouting & Wildlife Pressure
items.alt: THC outdoor cultivation infographic explaining outdoor scouting, pest pressure, wildlife damage and prevention-first monitoring.
items.caption: Frequent scouting and exclusion-first prevention make outdoor pest and wildlife problems easier to detect before damage compounds.

items.title: Sex Expression, Pollen Drift & Seed-Set Investigation
items.alt: THC outdoor cultivation infographic explaining sex expression, airborne pollen drift, unwanted pollination risk and seed-set investigation.
items.caption: Pollen risk is directional and uncertain; observation, wind context and plant inspection matter more than assuming a universal safe distance.

items.title: Season, Records, Microclimate & Contingency Planning
items.alt: THC outdoor cultivation infographic explaining seasonal records, local microclimates, weather contingencies and observation-based planning.
items.caption: Outdoor planning improves when local weather, microclimate observations and plant records are compared across the season.
